title: Abba Mari
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: “My father, my master.” This is how Rabbah son of Rav Huna referred to his father, who was his teacher, in [Gittin 29b](https://www.sefaria.org/Gittin.29b.16) and [Sanhedrin 5a](https://www.sefaria.org/Sanhedrin.5a.8). Hyman says Heilprin treated the phrase as the name of an amora and calls this “an error that issued from the ruler.”[^1]

notes.text: In Gittin, Rabbah reports what “my father, my master” said in Rav’s name. In Sanhedrin he traces his authorization through his father to Rav and earlier teachers. [Seder HaDorot](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2407&lang=en) gives a separate entry headed Abba Mari and quotes the Gittin transmission.
